scenarios.title: Subscriptions filter and sort persist across a fresh launch
scenarios.why: e477e5d: criteria moved from SavedStateHandle (lost on fresh launch) to DataStore; restored before first rows draw.
preconditions: At least 4 subscriptions named with {{tag}}, in at least two different statuses/categories/payers so a filter changes the list (e.g. two active and two inactive, or two categories)
Stored criteria cleared: app logged in fresh, no previous filter

steps.do: Open the Subscriptions list and note the default order and the full row count.
steps.expect: All {{tag}} subscriptions show, sorted by next payment.

steps.do: Open the filter sheet, pick one category (or status) that matches only some rows, and change the sort to a different option (e.g. Name or Price). Dismiss the sheet.
steps.expect: List shows only the matching rows in the new order; row count is smaller than before.

steps.do: Force-stop the app (adb shell am force-stop com.grappim.wallosmobile.debug) and relaunch it, then open the Subscriptions list.
steps.expect: The very first drawn list is already filtered and sorted the same way (no flash of the full unfiltered list); the filter sheet shows the chosen category and sort selected.

steps.do: Press Clear in the filter sheet, then force-stop and relaunch again.
steps.expect: Full list returns after Clear; after relaunch it is still unfiltered, but the previously chosen sort order is still applied (Clear leaves sort alone).

scenarios.title: Disconnecting drops the saved filter and sort
scenarios.why: e477e5d: ApiKeyStorage.clear() now also removes stored criteria in the same edit as the key.
preconditions: Logged in with a saved filter and non-default sort active (from previous scenario)

steps.do: Go to Settings and disconnect from the server, then log in again with the same credentials.
steps.expect: Login succeeds and the Subscriptions list opens.

steps.do: Look at the Subscriptions list and open the filter sheet.
steps.expect: No filter is applied (all rows visible), and sort is the default (Next payment).

scenarios.title: Merely opening the list does not overwrite saved criteria with defaults
scenarios.why: e477e5d: criteria are restored before persisting starts and only user changes are written (drop(1)); a regression would reset saved criteria on open.
preconditions: A filter and sort already saved from a previous run

steps.do: Force-stop and relaunch, open Subscriptions, do not touch the filter, navigate to another drawer screen and back, then force-stop and relaunch once more.
steps.expect: The saved filter and sort are still applied after both relaunches.

skipped.reason: Refactor only (SubscriptionsViewModel takes Json from DI); no behaviour change, and a DI qualifier/graph mistake would show up as a cold-start crash in every scenario above.
